channel.title: Projects on Home
channel.description: Recent content in Projects on Home

item.title: SabiYarn
item.description: A 125M parameter decoder-only language model pretrained from scratch on 70B tokens across 11 Nigerian languages. Best performing model on these languages at AfricaNLP, ACL 2025.

item.title: AIpplier
item.description: An LLM-based web automation agent that automates job applications on popular job boards, built with LangGraph, Playwright, and GPT-4o.

item.title: Zeeno
item.description: A semantic search-powered book recommendation service that lets you find books by describing topics or ideas you are thinking about in natural language.

item.title: Text Descrambler
item.description: A GPT-2 model fine-tuned to reconstruct grammatically correct sentences from randomly ordered word sequences — e.g. turning 'The expensive. show equations is computationally that' back into coherent prose.

item.title: TraceRoute
item.description: A Python implementation of the classic Unix traceroute utility, tracing the full path followed by an internet packet from source to destination across the network.
